summary: 当晚 ACDT #83 确认把 builder 存款和退出拆到独立合约（EIP-8282）是正确设计，新系统合约的安全审查估计需要 1 到 2 个月。Cyimon 在 Magicians 和 ethresear.ch 发布 pERC20 私密代币标准修订，主要新增扩展的 approve。Eli Ben-Sasson 披露 Starknet 隐私池一周 TVL 约 25 万美元，含 25 种代币。

keywords_en: 1 to 2 months of EIP-8282 security review
summary_en: In the evening ACDT #83 confirmed that separating builder deposits and exits into their own contracts (EIP-8282) is the right design, with an estimated 1 to 2 months of security review for the new system contracts. Cyimon posted a revision of the pERC20 private token standard on Magicians and ethresear.ch, mainly adding an extended approve. Eli Ben-Sasson said Starknet's privacy pool reached about $250K TVL in its first week, across 25 tokens.
